                             NOTICE OF RESULTS
            PHOENIX MAYOR’S COMMISSION ON DISABILITY ISSUES (MCDI)
                        VIRTUAL BI-MONTHLY MEETING

Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.02, notice was given to the members of the PHOENIX
MAYOR’S COMMISSION ON DISABILITY ISSUES and the public of an MCDI Virtual Bi-
Monthly Meeting on Wednesday, July 22, 2026, at 4:15 p.m.

The Mayor’s Commission on Disability Issues meeting was held via video conferencing platform.
The public was able to observe and listen to the live meeting. For more information of the meeting
format please contact Lisa Cherry, 602.261.8916 or lisa.cherry@phoenix.gov.

Executive Sessions – Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.03. (A) (1), (2), (3) and (4), the
Commission may vote to convene in executive session as permitted by the Arizona Open
Meeting Law to discuss, consider matters listed on the agenda, or confidential records exempt
by law from public inspection, and/or to consult with the Commission Attorney for legal advice
and to consider the Commission’s position and to instruct the Commission regarding any items
on the agenda. The Executive Session will not be open to the public. The Commission will take
action in public session.

The agenda for the meeting went as follows:

1. Call to Order, welcome, and Roll Call (1 minute) – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair
   Meeting called to Order at 4:19 p.m.

2. Action Item (2 minutes) – Approval of the May 27, 2026, Mayor’s Commission on
   Disability Issues Bi-Monthly Meeting Minutes – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair

   Approved

3. Action Item (2 minutes) – Approval of the June 17, 2026, Mayor’s Commission on
   Disability Issues Digital Environment and Physical Infrastructure (DE_PI) Subcommittee
   Meeting Minutes – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair

   Approved

4. Information and Discussion (20 minutes) – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Subcommittee
   Updates and/or next steps:
         a. Social Awareness Subcommittee
         b. Communication and Marketing Plan
         c. Digital Environment and Physical Infrastructure (DE/PI) Subcommittee

   Discussed
 5. Information, Discussion, and Possible Action (20 minutes) – Mayor’s Commission on
    Disability Issues – Disability Awards and Recognition Event (D.A.R.E.).
           a. D.A.R.E. Planning Committee
           b. D.A.R.E. Nomination Committee

     Discussed

 6. Information, Discussion, and Possible Action (5 minutes) – MCDI FY25-FY26 Strategic
    Annual Planning Outlook and Updates – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair.
          a. Education Awareness Webinar Recommendations
                  i. Vote the Spectrum and Civic Engagement (September 16, 2026) –
                     Commissioner Munoz
                 ii. Mental Health Awareness (TBD, 2026) – Commissioner Snead
          b. Commission Educational Awareness Presentations
                  i. Paratransit (September,18 2026) – Commissioner Steinmetz

     Discussed

 7. Announcements and Future Agenda Items (5 minutes) – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair.
      • The next virtual MCDI Digital Environment and Physical Infrastructure (DE_PI)
         Subcommittee meeting will be held on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 4:15 P.M.
      • The next virtual Bi-Monthly MCDI meeting will be held on Wednesday, September
         23, 2026, at 4:15 P.M.

     Announcements Made

 8. Call to the Public (3-minute limit) – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair
    • Those wishing to address the Commission need not request permission in advance.
       Action taken as a result of the public comment will be limited to directing staff to study
       the matter or rescheduling the matter for further consideration and decision at a later
       date.

     No Comments Made

9.   Adjournment – Nicole Anderson, MCDI Chair
     Meeting adjourned at 5:14 p.m.

 For more information on the meeting format, additional information, or to request a reasonable
 accommodation, please contact Lisa Cherry, Equal Opportunity Specialist/Commission Liaison of the
 Equal Opportunity Department at 602.261.8916, or TTY 602-534-1557 or 7-1-1 Friendly.
 https://www.phoenix.gov/eod/commissions/disabilityissues.

 Persons paid to lobby on behalf of persons or organizations other than themselves shall
 register with the City Clerk prior to lobbying or within five business days thereafter and must
 register annually to continue lobbying. If you have any questions about registration or if you
 must register, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at 602-262-6811.
